title: Preoperative Assessment of Aortic Valve Stenosis and Coronary Artery Disease
brief_summary: We sought to determine whether the dual-source computed tomography assessment of aortic valve stenosis and coronary artery disease is equivalent to or even better than conventional invasive coronary angiography and transthoracic echocardiography.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with aortic valve disease who were scheduled to undergo cardiac surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Hemodynamic instability
* Renal insufficiency (serum creatinine level \> 133umol/L)
* Known allergy to iodinated contrast agents
* Non-treated hyperthyreosis
